cs.t: Yes I do. I'm a bit of a collector in no serious sense. For "real work" I still use computer calculator (Qaculate or SpreedCrunch). But if I can I prefer one of my Casio fx-85gt. I have a Casio 115ES (I think) which has a solder jumper bridged to enable more features I've had this for over a decade I think. A sharp graphing programmable that has a few functions programmed in I occasionally use. If I'm doing something for fun I'd probably use some of the log tables I've made, sometimes the slide rules. Thanks for letting me talk about the topic I'm always trying to bring up...
cs.th: Ask HN: Do you still use a hand held/desktop calculator?
